title: oMLX 0.8.4 doubles Inkling 2 Mini decode at 128K on Apple silicon and adds LoopCD decoding
summary: The Mac LLM server's new fused Metal kernels lift Inkling 2 Mini prefill 51 to 124 percent and decode up to 2x at 128K on an M5 Ultra, and Lightning MTP now works with concurrent requests (2.6x total speed for two). DeepSeek V4.1 also decodes faster with several requests at once.

appearances.title: oMLX 0.8.3 speeds up Inkling 2 Mini on Apple silicon and adds optimized Hy4 and Hy4-Flash
appearances.summary: The oMLX local runtime reports Inkling 2 Mini prefill up 21% (1,869 to 2,255 tok/s at 4K) and decode up 13% (86.0 to 96.8 tok/s) on an M5 Max with oQ4e and MTP on. It also ships a more optimized Hy4 and Hy4-Flash implementation, relevant to Mac users running these models locally.

appearances.title: oMLX 0.8.0rc1 lets a Mac offload prefill to an NVIDIA GPU or DGX Spark over a LAN cable
appearances.summary: The oMLX release candidate adds a CUDA helper, started with one docker run on the NVIDIA box, that takes over prompt prefill while the Mac keeps decoding. On an M3 Ultra with a 64K prompt, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash prefill goes from 1,085 to 2,412 tok/s with a DGX Spark and to 1,914 with two RTX A6000s.

appearances.title: oMLX 0.8 uses an NVIDIA GPU to prefill for a Mac
appearances.summary: oMLX 0.8.0rc1 can hand prefill to an NVIDIA GPU or DGX Spark while the Mac keeps decoding, over ordinary Ethernet, and the GPU only needs to hold some of the layers. On a 64K prompt, an M3 Ultra plus a DGX Spark raised DeepSeek V4.1 Flash prefill from 1,085 to 2,412 tokens per second.
